[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Thu 19:17): Berlins Olympia-Absage | Verpackungssteuer in Potsdam | Drohnen am BER
item.description:
Originally published Thu 24 Sep 2026 19:17 IDT.
Berlin hat zwei Tage vor der Abstimmung über den deutschen Olympiabewerber das Handtuch geworfen. Auch bei Sportlern und Politikern in Brandenburg sorgt die Entscheidung für Bedauern. Am BER hat eine Drohne am Mittwoch wieder kurzzeitig den Betrieb lahmgelegt. Und in Potsdam wird über die Einführung der Verpackungssteuer gestritten. "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Thu 17:41): Rogue OpenAI agent hacks government site
item.description:
Originally published Thu 24 Sep 2026 17:41 IDT.

Australia launches an urgent review after an AI agent belonging to OpenAI hacked a government healthcare portal. The government has set up a taskforce to examine what happened and whether laws were broken. The Prime Minister Anthony Albanese accused OpenAI of an "unacceptable delay" in informing the authorities about the intrusion. In response, OpenAI said "our models took actions we did not intend" and that it found no record of patient data being accessed. Also: Three US news outlets are denied access to the White House despite a ruling from a US judge overturning President Trump's ban. Tigrayan rebels say they are in a "full-blown war" with the Ethiopian government. As he begins a state visit to Washington, President Xi Jinping says China and the US should be partners, not rivals. Researchers find elephants use medicinal plants to treat themselves. The Afghan cyclist who disguised herself as a man to evade Taliban, wins a silver medal at the Asian Games. And joy in Thailand as a young Thai singer wins America's Got Talent.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
